query: How do I apply as an undergrad?
text: Apply online through Admissions: it's free for Washington residents and takes about 30 minutes. First-year applicants can ask questions at an online First-Year Admissions Q&A, and Admissions can answer the rest.

query: What science programs do you offer?
text: Cascadia State offers bachelor's, master's, and certificate programs across the sciences, from biology, chemistry, and environmental science to computer science and data science.

query: When are campus tours this month?
text: {tours} Tours start at 10 a.m. If those days don't work, you can schedule a visit for another time.
